uncited: *   **Input:** An adjunction detail pyramid sequence $d_0, d_1, \dots, d_{L-1}$ and the coarsest approximation $f_L$ of the input volume data $f$.
Compute the MIP of the detail signal at level $j-1$: $P = M_\Theta(d_{j-1})$.
Expand this projection $j-1$ times using the 2D synthesis operator: $E = \tilde{\psi}_A^{j-1}(P)$.

*   **Monotonicity:** Because detail signals $d_{j-1}$ in an adjunction pyramid are non-negative, the projections $M_\Theta^{(j-1)}(f)$ are guaranteed to be greater than or equal to $M_\Theta^{(j)}(f)$.
A variant that uses an approximation pyramid instead of a detail pyramid.
